title: Cute mug, terrible packaging
text: Cute mug, terrible packaging. Cute mug, terrible packaging. This was purchased as a gift for my boss. I ended up repackaging it because not only was the box damaged, but it was just kind of shoddy and poor quality. The mug itself was really cute and she loved it.
